psychiatric referrals in Ghana were mostly from the medical clinics, and most were diagnosed as suffering mood (affective), neurotic and stress-related and substance use related disorders.
the most common diagnoses in the psychiatric out-patients of the Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital in Acca, Ghana, are mood (affective), and neurotic and anxiety related disorders.
Psychiatric disorders in the Ghanaian population are similar to those in other populations, with mood and neurotic disorders being the most frequent.
